d:
Is Rumi finally falling in love with Robbie? Chonch Ladhiyaan from the film Manmarziyaan beautifully captures the quiet, tender moments of love. Sung by Harshdeep Kaur and Jazim Sharma, the song reflects emotions through soulful melodies composed by Amit Trivedi.
Song : Chonch Ladhiyaan
Singers : Harshdeep Kaur, Jazim Sharma
Music : Amit Trivedi
Lyrics : Shellee
Produced & Arranged By : Amit Trivedi
Recording Engineers : Abhishek Sortey, Urmila Sutar (A T Studios, Mumbai)
Assisted By : Firoz Shaikh
